checks.finding: REQ-002–010, Roles and Permissions, and Main Workflows define supported owners, authorization stages, immutable bindings, reconciliation and verification outcomes sufficiently for design.

Recognizing existing owners does not imply executing unsupported owners; development approval explicitly excludes cloud writes. Historical #423 evidence is distinguished from this feature's future implementation.

Requirements Main Workflows requires dependency graphs where a failed predecessor blocks dependents and preserves successful-unit receipts; Edge Cases also requires an explicit no-op result without fake apply. AC-006 covers concurrency/replay/timeouts and AC-009 covers unhealthy or missing observations, but no acceptance scenario exercises either dependency-graph partial failure or no-op execution. A verifier could accept a suite that submits dependent writes after predecessor failure or fabricates an apply for an empty preview. These are missing observable product acceptance cases, not missing implementation detail; their safety and audit consequences justify Major.

Assumptions and Open Questions identify GitHub Actions, initial owners, and required target, federation, health, backup and budget inputs; missing deployment prerequisites block live operation rather than invite substitution.

REQ-004–006 and AC-004–006 require authenticated, distinct prepare/apply authorization at the write boundary, immutable binding, revocation/expiry rejection and replay protection. Cleanup requires separate authorization.

Supported execution paths, non-goals, cloud lifecycle, evidence classifications and deployment prerequisites are specified without requiring downstream reviewers to invent product behavior. The missing negative acceptance scenarios are reported separately under EDGE-CASE-COVERAGE.
